title: Straight on
shows: Two ways of the same road in a line, two lanes each way: the lanes meet edge to edge, no step, no gap.

title: A bend between two ways
shows: The road bends by 45° at the node where two ways meet: both are cut on the bisector of the bend.

title: A sharp bend
shows: A bend of 135° between two ways: the inner edges must not throw a spike.

title: A right-turn lane added
shows: A one-way road of two lanes gets a third lane on the right before a junction (turn:lanes=through|through|right): the new lane widens out from the kerb over about 25 m, the through lanes run straight.

title: A left-turn lane in the middle
shows: A two-way road of one lane each way gets a left-turn lane in its middle before a junction (lanes:forward=2, turn:lanes:forward=left|through): the new lane opens between the two directions, the through lane stays at the kerb.

title: Four lanes become two
shows: A two-way road of two lanes each way goes on with one lane each way: the outer lanes narrow to nothing.

title: An unmarked road meets a marked one
shows: A residential street without lane markings (width=8) goes on as a road with one lane each way (6 m): the kerbs ease from one width to the other, nothing narrows to a point.

title: T-junction
shows: A side street joins a main road of two lanes each way: the main road runs through, the side street stops at its kerb, the junction is filled, the main road’s kerb opens for the side street.

title: Crossroads with turn lanes
shows: A main road with a left-turn lane on each approach crosses a road of one lane each way: the main road runs through, the cross road stops at its kerbs, the turn arrows sit before the junction.

title: A skewed crossing
shows: Two roads cross at 60°, each one way through the node: the junction is a rhombus, the kerb curves at the sharp corners stay inside it.

title: A road splits into a dual carriageway
shows: A two-way road of two lanes each way splits into two one-way roads (traffic keeps right: the eastbound one to the south): no road runs through, the junction joins all three, each carriageway takes the lanes of its direction.

title: A dual carriageway crossed by a road
shows: A road crosses both carriageways of a dual carriageway; the piece between them is 24 m long: two junctions close together, which a good drawing shows as one.

title: A roundabout
shows: A ring of radius 30 m and two lanes with four roads of one lane each way: each road stops outside the ring, the ring runs on past them.

title: A bus lane ends
shows: A road with a bus lane on the right of its eastbound direction (bus:lanes:forward=|designated) goes on without it: the bus lane narrows to nothing at the kerb.

title: A cycle lane between the lanes
shows: The German pattern: a cycle lane between the through lane and the right-turn lane, in the lane keys but not in lanes (cycleway:lanes:forward=no|lane|no), before a junction with a side street; beyond the junction a plain road with cycle lanes on both sides (cycleway:both=lane).

title: The way line moves within the road
shows: A one-way road of two lanes is mapped along the left edge of its first lane (placement=left_of:1), and goes on mapped along its middle: the lanes stay where they are, only the way line moves.

title: A one-way road drawn against its traffic
shows: A one-way road of two lanes goes on as a way drawn the other way round (oneway=-1): the lanes and turn arrows carry on as if it were drawn along the traffic.

title: Staggered junction
shows: Two side streets join a main road from opposite sides 16 m apart: two junctions close together, the main road runs through both.

title: A slip road leaves
shows: A one-way road of three lanes loses its right lane to a slip road (highway=primary_link) leaving at a shallow angle: the slip road should start where the right lane is.

title: Two roads merge
shows: Two one-way roads of one lane each join into a one-way road of two lanes: each lane runs on into its side of the joined road.

title: Small streets without lane tags
shows: A residential street, a living street and a service road without any lane tags meet: each is drawn as one shared carriageway of an assumed width, muted, joined at the junction.

title: Widths per lane
shows: A road of one wide lane and one narrow lane each way (width:lanes) goes on with equal lanes: every lane eases to its new width, the centre line stays straight.
